Desirable: CSIR-UGC-NET/DBT-JRF/ICMR-JRF/GATE qualified preferred; experience in bacterial cultivation, identification, characterization, microbial consortia, metagenomics, molecular biology techniques like LC-MS/GC-MS; proficiency in scientific writing.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Gujarat Biotechnology University Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 01-10-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Gujarat Biotechnology University to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Biotechnology University Junior Research Fellow Vacancy Details 2026
Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow : M.Sc./M.Tech (Biotechnology/Dairy Science/Microbiology/Biochemistry or relevant life sciences discipline) with minimum 55% marks. Desirable: CSIR-UGC-NET/DBT-JRF/ICMR-JRF/GATE qualified preferred; experience in bacterial cultivation, identification, characterization, microbial consortia, metagenomics, molecular biology techniques like LC-MS/GC-MS; proficiency in scientific writing.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years. Age relaxation will be as per government rules. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: Salary/ Stipend
content_sections.text: Rs.36,000/- per month inclusive of HRA (NET/GATE qualified) or Rs.23,213/- fixed per month.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Biotechnology University Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Gujarat Biotechnology University Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 01-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Gujarat Biotechnology University to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Gujarat Biotechnology University JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at Gujarat Biotechnology University is 01 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position as per the official notification released by Gujarat Biotechnology University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc./M.Tech in Biotechnology, Dairy Science, Microbiology, Biochemistry, or a relevant life sciences discipline with a minimum of 55% marks.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post is 35 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the JRF role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 23,213 to Rs. 36,000 per month, depending on qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from outside Gujarat apply for this position?
faq.answer: The notification invites applications from eligible candidates in Gujarat. It is advisable to check the detailed eligibility criteria in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Is the JRF position a permanent or contractual role?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position is a contractual role as per the information provided in the recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF and the online application link can be found in the "Important Links" section of this article.
